title: Adaptive Frequency Threshold Byte Pair Encoding for Mixed Natural Language and Structured Symbolic Corpora
abstract: arXiv:2610.32921v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Modern language models rely on subwording tokenization to define the discrete units of input processing, typically using methods like Byte Pair Encoding (BPE) that treat whitespace as a fixed semantic boundary. This design is inherently limited, as many meaningful concepts---including multiword expressions and the structured environments of formal languages like LaTeX---frequently span across whitespaces. While recent superword tokenization methods attempt to address this by relaxing whitespace constraints, they often rely on greedy frequency-driven merging that fails to account for token length or the specific needs of underrepresented domain-specific languages. In this paper, we introduce Adaptive Frequency Threshold Byte Pair Encoding (AdaBPE), a new tokenization method that leverages an adaptive frequent-pattern mining approach. translated_abstract: 现代语言模型依赖子词分词来定义输入处理的离散单元，通常采用字节对编码（BPE）等方法，将空白字符视为固定的语义边界。这种设计存在固有局限，因为许多有意义的概念——包括多词表达以及诸如LaTeX等形式语言的结构化环境——经常跨越空白字符。尽管近期的超词分词方法试图通过放宽空白约束来解决这一问题，但它们通常依赖贪心的频率驱动合并方式，未能考虑词元长度或资源不足的领域特定语言的具体需求。在本文中，我们提出了自适应频率阈值字节对编码，这是一种利用自适应频繁模式挖掘方法的新型分词方法。AdaBPE具有双重动态特性：它基于……的长度自适应调整最小频率阈值（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出AdaBPE，一种基于自适应频率阈值的频繁模式挖掘分词方法，通过动态调整合并策略，更好地处理跨越空白的多词表达和LaTeX等结构化符号内容。
